How to install[/size][/color]
This is an overwrite mod,
so add files to content file in the Stardew valley file and let it overwrite,
do not! repeat do not put it on Smapi cause it won't work since it does not include a manifest!
feel free to create a content patcher since I'm clueless on how to make one,
and if you do, please share the link so that I can give you the credit you deserve!
(Huge Kudos for Invartorzen and KeionDryke for inspiring me, And Specially Rekooooon for making the Shane girl Mod, please check their files!)
